description: This file defines the AclEntry interface, representing an access control list (ACL) entry with methods for creating new instances, retrieving authorization subjects, permissions, and converting to JSON. It is part of the package related to 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto model.

classes.name: AclEntry
classes.description: Interface representing a single ACL entry containing an authorization subject and permissions, with methods for instantiation, permission checks, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new immutable AclEntry with a specified authorization subject and permissions.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the JSON schema versions supported by this ACL entry, specifically version 1.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubject
methods.description: Retrieves the authorization subject associated with this ACL entry.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the specific permission is granted in this ACL entry.

methods.name: containsAll
methods.description: Checks if all permissions in the provided collection are granted in this ACL entry.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns the set of permissions associated with this ACL entry.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes this ACL entry to a JSON object including non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson (overloaded)
methods.description: Serializes this ACL entry to JSON with a specified schema version and field selector.
